correctness.rationale: Conditioning on the endpoint group gives the lower bound and exact equality conditions. The normalized support is a positive combination of cumulative-cut indicators; the L2 triangle inequality gives the upper bound and strictness. Explicit coalescing sequences establish sharpness, and continuity on the connected strict-support region gives the full interval.

value.rationale: The theorem completely refines two classical complementary variance-range inequalities when category or frequency weights are known. It gives both sharp constants, all endpoint attainment behavior, and simple equal-frequency formulas, so it is a natural structural classification rather than a routine numerical special case.
